passages.text: The museum guide gives our group a card with a drawing of a small key. We must follow three clues to find the room shown on the back. As we pass under a low arch, Mia notices the same key shape above a doorway. The next clue sends us to a room with a large model ship. We compare its flag with our card and discover the final sign. This small adventure makes us look carefully instead of hurrying past the displays. At the end, we return the card and explain which clue was hardest.

parallelText.en: The museum guide gives our group a card with a drawing of a small key.
parallelText.zh: 博物馆导游给小组一张画着小钥匙的卡片。

parallelText.en: We must follow three clues to find the room shown on the back.
parallelText.zh: 我们要跟随三条线索，找到卡片背面所示的房间。

parallelText.en: As we pass under a low arch, Mia notices the same key shape above a doorway.
parallelText.zh: 我们从低矮拱门下向前走时，米娅注意到门洞上方有相同的钥匙形状。

parallelText.en: The next clue sends us to a room with a large model ship.
parallelText.zh: 下一条线索把我们引到有大船模型的房间。

parallelText.en: We compare its flag with our card and discover the final sign.
parallelText.zh: 我们把船旗和卡片对照，发现最后的标志。

parallelText.en: This small adventure makes us look carefully instead of hurrying past the displays.
parallelText.zh: 这次小小探险让我们仔细观察，而不是匆匆走过展品。

parallelText.en: At the end, we return the card and explain which clue was hardest.
parallelText.zh: 最后，我们归还卡片，说明哪条线索最难。

passages.text: Our class visits a new sports facility beside the school field. It has an exercise room, changing rooms and a place to fill water bottles. Before trying anything, we walk around with the coach and read the simple instructions. After a short run, I stop in the rest area and breathe steadily. The coach asks us to notice the space around each piece of equipment. We draw a plan showing where people can move, rest and get water. Our plans help the next class find what it needs without crowding one doorway.

parallelText.en: Our class visits a new sports facility beside the school field.
parallelText.zh: 我们班参观学校操场旁的新运动设施。

parallelText.en: It has an exercise room, changing rooms and a place to fill water bottles.
parallelText.zh: 里面有运动室、更衣室，还有接饮用水的地方。

parallelText.en: Before trying anything, we walk around with the coach and read the simple instructions.
parallelText.zh: 尝试设备之前，我们先随教练参观，阅读简单说明。

parallelText.en: After a short run, I stop in the rest area and breathe steadily.
parallelText.zh: 短跑后，我在休息区停下，平稳地呼吸。

parallelText.en: The coach asks us to notice the space around each piece of equipment.
parallelText.zh: 教练让我们留意每件设备周围的空间。

parallelText.en: We draw a plan showing where people can move, rest and get water.
parallelText.zh: 我们画一张平面图，标出活动、休息和接水的位置。

parallelText.en: Our plans help the next class find what it needs without crowding one doorway.
parallelText.zh: 我们的图帮助下一班找到所需地点，不全挤在一个门口。
